levels.surface: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

notes: «بلغني أنك حدثت عن عبد الله بن عمرو» — the text names Uqba as the one met and asked, so Uqba is written as the link, not as an unnamed gap (rule 8)
the last link is Abdullah b. Amr, whose report of the Prophet is the saying; «قال أقط قلت نعم» is the exchange with Uqba, left out
